args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter headline: "Warehouse automation in 2026" — highlights growing adoption of autonomous warehouse systems, with a linked deep-dive article and companion piece.
- Linked article: Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates, but full system integration took roughly twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The single biggest cost saving from automation came from a reduction in mis-picks (picking errors), rather than from speed gains alone.

Note: The newsletter's companion link included a tracking parameter requesting it be appended with your personal email address (?email=<your email>). I used the clean/direct companion URL found in the article instead, to avoid transmitting your email to an external tracking endpoint.
